Deepak Kumar @ Deepak Kumar Paswan vs The State Of Bihar
on 19 June, 2023

Author: Sunil Kumar Panwar
Bench: Sunil Kumar Panwar
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.63797 of 2022
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-113 Year-2022 Thana- Chausa District- M

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
======================================================
 Deepak Kumar @ Deepak Kumar Paswan Son Of Jaldhar Paswan R/O Vill.-
 Dahra, P.S.- Warari Semapur, Distt.,- Katihar ... ...

Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Bihar ... ...

Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Uday Chand Prasad
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Indu Kumari Srivastava
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Kumar Panwar
 Oral Order
3 19-06-2023

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner has prayed for bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 363,
366, 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
As per allegation in the FIR, petitioner and other accused persons enticed the informant's minor daughter and kidnapped her by scorpio.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
No one is the eye witness of the occurrence.
There is delay of seven days in lodging the FIR, which creates doubt in authenticity of the prosecution story.
Petitioner has got no criminal antecedent and he is languishing in judicial custody since 8.6.2022.

Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.63797 of 2022(10) dt.19-06-2023 Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that statement of the victim girl was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., wherein she has made direct allegation of wrong doing against the petitioner.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration that there is direct allegation of committing wrong against the petitioner upon the minor girl of the informant, I am not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner and, as such, his application for bail is rejected.
